rationale: We landed on the regional homepage (en-lt), which has no PLP grid until a category is selected and may show consent/geo overlays. Normalizing to the international locale (en-int) and starting from a stable category PLP avoids the empty state. Added dismissors for OneTrust cookies and geo continue, robust PLP/PDP selectors, and URL rules to keep within moncler.com retail paths and avoid monclergroup.com.
code_hints: Set Accept-Language to en to encourage en-int routing.
After navigation, attempt optional clicks on selectors.dismiss.cookie and selectors.dismiss.geo, then wait for selectors.plp.container.
If still on homepage after normalization, open the mega-menu and click a category link (e.g., a[href*='/en-int/men/ready-to-wear/jackets']).
On PDP, if CSS price is missing, parse application/ld+json for offers.price and currency.
